comment: Blood Sun step 2: LOTUS FIELD TAPS TWO LANDS, THEN SACRIFICES THEM. Three untapped basics; the Field enters tapped and its trigger sacrifices two lands (the menu's front pick -- the scenario harness has no human sacrifice chooser -- two basics, never the Field itself: LotusSacrificeRanking puts the lowest per-tap yield first). Each untapped victim is tapped for its mana in response first (the trigger uses the stack; the mana floats until the phase ends), so the two floated mana plus the surviving land pay Demonic Tutor {1}{B}: nothing is dropped.
